title: 第19章 雷霆剑意大圆满第20章 双符加持又猛又快
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 星意洞，其实也是一个秘境空间。
天星武院有许多秘境，涵盖各方各面。
提升修为的纯元秘境，增加实战经验的妖兽秘境，以及专门用于考核的七星秘境。
星意洞，则是一个充斥着大量意境气息的洞穴类型秘境。
即便穆婉是天璇宫之主，也不能直接带秦逸进入星意洞。
秦逸缴纳了一千星辰点后，看守星意洞的天星武院长老，这才让秦逸进去。
穆婉带着秦逸，站在星意洞的边缘。
秦逸的目光看着下方。
星意洞仿佛深不见底。
穆婉道：“你爹当年进入了星意洞的底部，留下了一件东西。”
“这件事只有我知道。”
“他告诉我，如果你能在二十岁之前，抵达星意洞底部，就能找到那件东西。”
“倘若你过了二十岁都没有拿到那件东西，他留下的一些布置，便会将那件东西彻底毁掉。”
秦逸深吸了一口气，道：“宫主，我进去试试。”
穆婉点了点头，道：“你掌握有雷霆剑意，可以选择雷霆剑意开始，先将雷霆剑意提升到圆满！”
秦逸嗯了一声。
他昨日观看新人手册，已经知晓星意洞的情况。
在星意洞内，根本不能使用元力，只能使用意境的力量。
越是往下，意境的力量就越强。
唯有用意境对抗，才能不断深入。
“虽然星意洞内，危险不大，但你也要小心一些，如果撑不住了，就不要继续强行深入，不然，会造成灵魂受伤。”
“你现在不可能抵达星意洞底部，但毫无疑问，你以后会经常来这里，所以现在就当是好好感受一番，熟悉星意洞的环境。”
穆婉叮嘱道。
秦逸表示明白，下一刻，便纵身一跃，身体朝着下方快速坠去。
刹那间，秦逸就感受到，星意洞内，弥漫着一股特殊的气机，封印了他体内的元力。
四面八方，充斥着驳杂混乱的气息。
无形之中，似有狂风呼啸，烈火熊熊，寒冰如刃，雷霆肆虐……
秦逸心念一动，雷霆剑意轰然爆发，他身边缭绕雷光，破开周围的混乱意境之力，继续下坠。
片刻后，秦逸身边的雷光剧烈闪烁，明灭不定，他所掌握的意境之力，已经快要支撑不住了。
现在来看，距离抵达星意洞的底部，还有较大的差距，但秦逸并未沮丧。
现在不行，不代表一直不行。
他来这里试一试，也还可以增强自身的雷霆剑意。
紧接着，秦逸在这星意洞边缘的岩壁上，发现了一个闪烁着雷光的洞府。
这种洞府，在星意洞的岩壁上，有很多。
每一个洞府，都蕴含着不同的意境之力。
越往下的洞府，蕴含的意境之力就越强。
秦逸找到了目前最适合他的雷霆意境洞府，当即一步踏出，冲了过去，他进入洞府之中，顿时就发现，周围再无驳杂的意境气息，只有纯粹的雷霆意境。
他沿着通道走，来到尽头后，一个小小的空间映入眼帘。
content_en:
Xingyi Cave is actually a secret space.
There are many secret realms in Tianxing Martial Arts Academy, covering all aspects.
The Pure Yuan Secret Realm to enhance cultivation, the Demonic Beast Secret Realm to increase actual combat experience, and the Seven-Star Secret Realm specially used for assessment.
Xingyi Cave is a cave-type secret realm filled with a lot of artistic conception.
Even if Mu Wan is the master of Tianxuan Palace, he cannot directly take Qin Yi into Xingyi Cave.
After Qin Yi paid a thousand star points, the elder of the Tianxing Martial Arts Academy who guarded the Xingyi Cave allowed Qin Yi to enter.
Mu Wan took Qin Yi and stood at the edge of Xingyi Cave.
Qin Yi looked down.
The Xingyi Cave seems to be bottomless.
Mu Wan said: "Your father entered the bottom of Xingyi Cave and left something behind."
"Only I know about this."
"He told me that if you can reach the bottom of Xingyi Cave before you are twenty years old, you can find that thing."
"If you don't get that thing after you are twenty years old, some of the arrangements he left behind will completely destroy that thing."
Qin Yi took a deep breath and said, "Palace Master, let me go in and try."
Mu Wan nodded and said: "You have the Thunder Sword Intent, you can choose the Thunder Sword Intent to start, and first improve the Thunder Sword Intent to perfection!"
Qin Yi hummed.
He read the newcomer's manual yesterday and already knew the situation of Xingyi Cave.
In the Xingyi Cave, you cannot use Yuan Power at all, you can only use the power of artistic conception.
The further down you go, the stronger the power of the artistic conception.
Only by confronting with artistic conception can we continue to deepen.
"Although there is not much danger in the Xingyi Cave, you should be careful. If you can't hold on any longer, don't continue to force yourself deeper. Otherwise, your soul will be injured."
"It is impossible for you to reach the bottom of Xingyi Cave now, but there is no doubt that you will come here often in the future, so now you should feel it and become familiar with the environment of Xingyi Cave."
Mu Wan warned.
Qin Yi expressed his understanding, and the next moment, he jumped up and fell rapidly downwards.
In an instant, Qin Yi felt that there was a special energy filling the Xingyi Cave, sealing the Yuan Power in his body.
In all directions, there is a chaotic atmosphere.
Invisibly, there seemed to be strong winds howling, blazing fire, ice like blades, and thunder raging...
With a thought in Qin Yi's mind, the Thunder Sword Intent suddenly erupted. Thunder light surrounded him, breaking through the power of the chaotic artistic conception around him, and he continued to fall.
After a moment, the thunder light around Qin Yi flickered violently, flickering on and off. The power of artistic conception he controlled was almost unable to support it.
Looking at it now, there is still a big gap between reaching the bottom of Xingyi Cave, but Qin Yi is not depressed.
Just because it doesn't work now doesn't mean it won't always work.
He came here to give it a try, and he could also enhance his Thunder Sword Intent.
Immediately afterwards, Qin Yi discovered a cave with lightning flashing on the rock wall at the edge of the Xingyi Cave.
There are many such caves on the rock walls of Xingyi Cave.
Each cave contains the power of different artistic conceptions.
The further down the cave, the stronger the power of artistic conception contained.
Qin Yi found the thunder artistic conception cave that was most suitable for him at present. He immediately stepped out and rushed over. When he entered the cave, he immediately found that there was no mixed artistic conception around him, only pure thunder artistic conception.
He walked along the passage, and when he reached the end, a small space came into view.
